mapper.select: SELECT id, role_name AS roleName, permissions, `desc`, default_permissions AS defaultPermissions, systemic FROM role ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role (role_name, permissions, `desc`, default_permissions, systemic) VALUES (#{roleName}, #{permissions}, #{desc}, #{defaultPermissions}, #{systemic})
mapper.update: UPDATE role SET role_name = #{roleName}, permissions = #{permissions}, `desc` = #{desc} WHERE id = #{id} AND systemic = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM role WHERE id = #{id} AND systemic = 0
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.role_name FROM users u JOIN role r ON JSON_CONTAINS(u.role, CAST(r.id AS CHAR)) WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.status = 1
